Review LottieFiles?

Reviewers largely see LottieFiles as a reliable, go-to source for ready-to-use animations, especially for web, UI, Canva, and Figma workflows. They praise the breadth of the library, frequent feature updates, easy sharing, and simple color customization that helps teams stay on brand and produce animations without deeper motion-design tools. The main complaints are about product clarity rather than capability: editing can feel confusing, the UX is described as sparse, and color controls and tool-list details could be better polished.

Woah! This is a GAME CHANGING partnership for Canva users. Lotties are SO much fun to use and being able to add brand colors within the App and transform your animations to be ON brand in a click is so helpful. I can't wait to see what businesses and brands do with them. As a Canva Creator (I make templates for the Canva library) and Canva Verified Expert, I am always looking recommending ways for my community to add movement and interest to their Canva designs and videos. So, this has opened up a world of possibilities. I am sure we are going to see this get even better with this LottieFiles + Canva partnership.
